title: Coin input irrelevance
statement: Let $P$ be a program containing no coin instructions. For any input bit list $x$, word width $W$, time bound $t$, output bit $v$, emitted bit list $o$, space bound $f$, and coin lists $\rho,\rho'$, the program halts within those bounds on input $x$ with coin list $\rho$, output $o$, and result $v$ if and only if it does so with coin list $\rho'$.
hypotheses_covered: The program contains no coin instruction
The two coin lists are arbitrary
